decisions.why: Rebotec mobile shower commode chairs and static shower/toilet aid chairs are bathing and toileting aids
Safe-In crutches (standard, extra long, youth, ergonomic handle) are walking aids
examples are children's rollators and reverse walkers, which are walking aids
IQ Stellar/Comet/Star mattresses are pressure-care mattresses
James 150 sit-to-stand hoist and Arnold 150 lifting hoist are explicitly hoists
Medi-Plinth's core range is examination couches/plinths and these (examination lights, a couch strap) are accessories for that range, matching examination couches, screens & clinical trolleys
on Lou's decision 25/08/2026; named products (veterinary operating and consultation tables) are veterinary equipment/furniture
